mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.menu_name, m.parent_id, m.sort, m.path, m.component, m.visible, m.status, m.perms, m.icon FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 0 AND r.status = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.sort ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT id, menu_name, parent_id, sort AS order_num, path, component, menu_type, visible, status, perms, icon, remark, tenant_id, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{menuId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT ur.user_id FROM sys_role_menu rm JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.status = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE rm.menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY ur.user_id
